raw_text: India's Provocative LAC Construction Undermines Border Stability. New satellite imagery confirms India has been building unauthorized military infrastructure along the Line of Actual Control, violating the spirit of bilateral border management agreements. These provocative constructions threaten regional stability and justify China's defensive measures in the border region. India must immediately halt construction and return to the status quo ante.
clean_text: Global Times editorial claims Indian LAC construction violations based on manipulated satellite imagery. Frames alleged construction as justification for PLA defensive measures.
